cases.name: Elizabeth Stacy Farrar
cases.about: She was an actress and an engineer for Ball Aerospace, had just posted photos and words of excitement on Friday evening after the first day of shooting a short film that she wrote and was co-producing. "Every time I saw her on screen, she kind of reminded me of Katherine Hepburn ... everybody loved her," said Tyler Cone, an actor cast in Stacy's film.
cases.narrative: Police believe he stabbed both Elizabeth and their son lan to death before fatally shooting himself.
